data.title: A single Bitcoin transaction carried an average water footprint of about 16,000 litres in 2021 once the electricity and cooling behind it were counted — roughly 6.2 million times the water behind one credit-card swipe, and the figure rises and falls with the price of Bitcoin itself
data.description: As Bitcoin's price swings, so does its hidden cost in freshwater—each transaction now demands enough water to fill an Olympic swimming pool.
